The '''''Journal of Chemometrics''''' is a monthly [[peer review|peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] published since 1987 by [[John Wiley & Sons]]. It publishes original scientific papers, reviews, and short communications on fundamental and applied aspects of [[chemometrics]]. The current [[editor-in-chief]] is Cyril Ruckebusch ([[University of Lille]]).

== Abstracting and indexing ==
''Journal of Chemometrics'' is abstracted and indexed in:
* [[Chemical Abstracts Service]]
* [[Scopus]]
* [[Web of Science]]
According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2020 [[impact factor]] of 2.467, ranking it 27th out of 64 journals in the category "Instruments & Instrumentation",<ref name=WoS1>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Instruments & Instrumentation |title=2020 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref> 35th out of 63 journals in the category "Automation & Control Systems",<ref name=WoS2>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Automation & Control Systems |title=2020 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=Thomson Reuters |edition=Science |series=Web of Science }}</ref> 30th out of 125 journals in the category "Statistics & Probability",<ref name=WoS3>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Statistics & Probability |title=2020 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=Thomson Reuters |edition=Science |series=Web of Science }}</ref> 40th out of 108 journals in the category "Mathematics Interdisciplinary Applications",<ref name=WoS4>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Mathematics Interdisciplinary Applications |title=2020 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=Thomson Reuters |edition=Science |series=Web of Science }}</ref> and 54th out of 87 journals in the category "Chemistry Analytical",<ref name=WoS5>{{cite book |year=2021 |chapter=Journals Ranked by Impact: Chemistry Analytical |title=2020 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=Thomson Reuters |edition=Science |series=Web of Science }}</ref>
